Name: statement_object_decomposition
Title: Statement–Object Decomposition of Sum-Pooling Networks
Short Hypothesis: For networks that sum-pool ReLU per-particle features, Σ_i ReLU(w·x_i+b) = b·|A| + w·Σ_{i∈A} x_i makes every pooled channel an object defined by one cut. Layer-wise naming plus stage-by-stage substitution yields a decomposition that is exact where the identity holds and is validated causally.
Related Work: Decision-tree extraction from ReLU nets; symbolic regression (Cranmer et al. 2020); EFN/PFN; KANs; linear probes and SAEs.
Experiments: baselines: tree extraction, symbolic regression, probes on the same networks
Risk Factors and Limitations: Exactness only up to the first nonlinearity after pooling; later layers need fitted formulas.
